_why: The only recorded riscv32i run (c-hd-clock_period20, AREA 0, 20 ns) measured its ss-corner min_period at 22.45 ns (WNS -2.451) and carried 162 max-slew, 81 max-fanout and 18 antenna violations. The period here is that measurement plus 5% — the same rule propose_repairs() applies — and RUN_POST_GRT_DESIGN_REPAIR is on because the DRVs are what that step exists to fix and no riscv32i run has ever executed it. AREA 3 is the strategy OpenLane's SynthesisExploration ranked best for slack on this design (2026-09-10, 9 strategies in one pass: AREA 3 ws -8.64 / 11,315 gates vs AREA 0 ws -15.65 / 5,423 gates, pre-PnR at 20 ns); AREA 0 is the one with a post-route measurement. Two candidates, so the strategy question gets a post-route answer instead of a pre-PnR guess.
